meta.title: Al-Qaryah Al-Turathiyah | Heritage Village Restaurant | Tabuk
meta.description: Al-Qaryah Al-Turathiyah in Tabuk — authentic Saudi heritage dining with traditional floor seating, group platters, and event hosting in a grand traditional space

hero.headline: Al-Qaryah Al-Turathiyah
hero.tagline: A heritage restaurant in the heart of Tabuk offering the authentic taste of Saudi tradition in an atmosphere of warmth and welcome

hospitality.paragraph_1: At Al-Qaryah Al-Turathiyah, we offer more than meals — we offer an authentic Saudi hospitality experience that reflects the heritage of our ancestors and the values of their generosity. From the moment you enter, you will feel the warmth of welcome that the people of the Arabian Peninsula have been known for across the ages.
hospitality.paragraph_2: Our expansive space has been designed to evoke the traditional Saudi village, with comfortable floor seating and an intimate atmosphere that brings family and friends together around a shared table.

items.text: A wonderful place that truly reflects authentic Saudi heritage. The floor seating is very comfortable and the food is delicious. An unforgettable experience, especially for visitors from outside the region.
items.author: Abu Mohammed

items.text: We organized dinner for a tourist group of 30 people and the coordination was excellent. The food was ready on time and the service was outstanding.
items.author: Khalid Al-Otaibi

items.text: The space is huge and perfect for events. The Kabsa and Mandi are among the best I have tasted in Tabuk. I recommend it to everyone.
items.author: Sarah

location.directions_note: Easily accessible from all parts of Tabuk. Centrally located in Al-Faisaliyah Al-Shamaliyah district.
